issues.t: CVT whine, shudder or slipping
issues.sym: A whining or droning noise that rises with speed, shudder when pulling away, slipping, or weak acceleration.
issues.why: The early Xtronic CVT in these Rogues is prone to wear inside the transmission. Nissan extended CVT warranty coverage on 2003-2010 CVT models, though that coverage has largely run out by age.
issues.next: Have shudder, whine or slipping diagnosed promptly and keep the CVT fluid changed with the correct Nissan fluid. If it slips badly or loses power, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may switch off with an adult seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag OFF light stays on with an adult in the front seat.
issues.why: The front passenger occupant sensor could interrupt its signal, making the system think the seat is empty and turn the airbag off.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is fixed, avoid seating an adult up front if the airbag OFF light is on.

issues.t: Steering gear cover screw may loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Steering feels loose, clunks, or responds oddly.
issues.why: A screw on the steering gear cover could work loose over time, which could eventually lead to a loss of steering control.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If the steering feels loose or clunks, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.t: Driver-side wiring connector can corrode and short (recall)
issues.sym: Wet carpet on the driver's side, a burning smell, or odd electrical faults such as warning lights or windows not working.
issues.why: Water and road salt tracked in on shoes can reach a wiring connector under the driver's side floor, corrode it and cause a short with a fire risk. The 2014 Rogue Select is included too.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and keep the driver's floor dry. If you smell burning, park the car away from buildings and have it inspected.

issues.t: Power steering assist may cut out (recall)
issues.sym: The steering suddenly becomes very heavy, often with a warning light.
issues.why: A circuit board in the electric power steering control unit may have been assembled out of position, so it can lose power assist.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Check your VIN for this recall. If the steering turns heavy, slow down, pull over safely, and have the car checked before driving on.

issues.t: CVT judder, hesitation and failure
issues.sym: Shudder or judder when accelerating, hesitation, whining, a transmission warning light, or reduced power.
issues.why: The CVT in this generation has a record of overheating and premature wear in the valve body and torque converter. A class settlement extended powertrain coverage on these years.
issues.next: Get symptoms diagnosed early and ask a Nissan dealer whether extended CVT coverage still applies to your VIN. If the car loses power or the warning light stays on, do not keep driving normally; have it checked right away.

issues.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Rough running, then the engine stalls and may not restart.
issues.why: Poorly plated parts inside the fuel pump can wear and cause the pump to stop working.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Check your VIN for both fuel pump recalls. If the engine stumbles or stalls, get off the road safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Liftgate support struts can corrode and break (recall)
issues.sym: The liftgate will not stay up or drops suddenly.
issues.why: The gas struts that hold up the liftgate can corrode and break, letting the heavy gate fall on someone.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is done, do not trust the liftgate to stay open by itself.

issues.t: Under-dash connector corrosion (recall)
issues.sym: Power windows or other electrical items stop working, warning lights come on, or the battery runs down.
issues.why: Water and salt that collect in the footwell can corrode a wiring connector under the dashboard.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and keep floor mats and carpets dry.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag OFF light is lit even though an adult is sitting there.
issues.why: The occupant classification system may misjudge who is in the seat and turn the passenger airbag off.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it reprogrammed. Avoid seating an adult up front while the OFF light is on.

issues.t: Folding key can fold and shut off engine (recall)
issues.sym: The flip-out key folds shut while in the ignition, and bumping it can turn the engine off while driving.
issues.why: The flip key's folding mechanism can release, and a closed key hanging in the ignition is easier to knock into the off position.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get the replacement key. Until then, keep heavy key rings off it and avoid bumping the key with your knee.

issues.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake pressed (recall)
issues.sym: The gear lever moves out of Park without pressing the brake pedal.
issues.why: The shift lock that should hold the lever in Park until the brake is pressed may not work, so the car could be shifted accidentally and roll.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Always set the parking brake and keep children away from the shifter until it is repaired.

issues.t: Dash wiring connector can corrode (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell, electrical faults, or warning lights, often after water gets into the cabin.
issues.why: Water can get into a wiring connector behind the dash and corrode it, which creates a fire risk.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you smell burning, park outside away from buildings and have it inspected.

issues.t: Hybrid brake booster may lose power assist (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal suddenly feels hard and the car takes more effort and distance to stop, sometimes with a warning light.
issues.why: The electric brake booster on the Rogue Hybrid can overheat and stop providing assist.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Rear camera image can disappear (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera picture does not show when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Certain display settings could hide the rear camera image.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall; the dealer updates the settings. Use mirrors and look back carefully until then.

issues.t: Rear brake calipers may leak fluid (recall)
issues.sym: A soft brake pedal, fluid near a rear wheel, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: Some rear brake calipers may have been built without a bushing, which can let brake fluid leak and reduce braking.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN for this recall. If the pedal is soft or the brake light is on, do not drive; have it towed.

issues.t: Second-row child seat tether anchors may be poorly welded (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom you would notice; a tethered child seat may not stay anchored in a crash.
issues.why: The upper tether anchors for the second row may not have been welded properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it repaired before relying on those anchors for a child seat.

issues.t: Fuel pump may overheat and fail (recall)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, loses power, and may stall while driving.
issues.why: The fuel pump can overheat and stop working, cutting fuel to the engine.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If the engine stalls or stumbles, get off the road safely and have it towed.

issues.t: VC-Turbo engine bearing failure (recall)
issues.sym: Knocking or rattling from the engine, loss of power, warning lights, or the engine quitting.
issues.why: Bearings in the variable compression turbo engine may have manufacturing defects and can fail. In bad cases the engine block can crack and leak hot oil, which can start a fire.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get the software update and inspection. If the engine knocks or loses power, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Engine oil can break down and seize bearings (recall)
issues.sym: Engine knocking, warning lights, loss of power or a sudden engine stall.
issues.why: At high temperatures the engine oil can break down, leaving bearings without proper protection so they can seize.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you hear knocking or the oil light comes on, pull over and shut the engine off.

issues.t: Front seat belt pretensioners may be built wrong (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom you would notice; the belts may not tighten as designed in a crash.
issues.why: Some front seat belt pretensioners may have been assembled incorrectly and might not restrain occupants properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it repaired promptly.

issues.t: Electronic throttle body gears may break (recall)
issues.sym: The car suddenly loses power or goes into a low-power mode, usually with warning lights.
issues.why: Gears inside the electronic throttle body can break, which cuts the engine's ability to make power.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If the car loses power, get to a safe spot and have it towed.

issues.t: Rearview camera screen may stay blank (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A software error can keep the rearview camera image from showing.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get the software update. Use mirrors and look back carefully until then.

issues.t: Selected gear may not show on the dash (recall)
issues.sym: The instrument panel does not display which gear the car is in.
issues.why: An instrument panel fault can keep the gear indicator from showing, so the driver may not know whether the car is in Drive, Reverse or Park.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Confirm the gear before moving off and always set the parking brake until it is fixed.

issues.t: CVT drops into fail-safe mode and limits speed
issues.sym: The car suddenly will not accelerate normally and feels held back to a low speed, sometimes after climbing a hill or towing in hot weather.
issues.why: The CVT control valve body and overheated fluid make the transmission protect itself by cutting power; Nissan addressed it with a new valve assembly and an add-on fluid cooler.
issues.next: Have it diagnosed soon, since repeated overheating shortens the life of the transmission; ask whether the cooler kit and valve body bulletin apply.

issues.t: All-wheel-drive coupling judders in slow tight turns
issues.sym: On all-wheel-drive models, a shudder, binding or groan from the rear when turning sharply at low speed on dry pavement, such as in a parking lot.
issues.why: The electronically controlled coupling that feeds the rear wheels can fail and stay partly engaged, so the rear axle fights the turn.
issues.next: Have the rear coupling checked; it is a major part, so get it diagnosed before it damages the rear driveline.

issues.t: Oil cooler gasket leaks engine oil
issues.sym: Oil weeping down the side of the engine, an oil smell after driving, and drops on the driveway.
issues.why: The gasket where the oil cooler meets the engine block hardens and lets oil seep out at the top of the cooler.
issues.next: Have the gasket replaced and keep an eye on the oil level until it is fixed.

issues.t: EVAP vent valve sticks and lights the check engine light
issues.sym: Check engine light with an evaporative system code, and sometimes trouble getting the fuel nozzle to run without clicking off.
issues.why: The vent control valve for the fuel vapor system can stick from dirt and moisture; an updated valve is available.
issues.next: Have the code read and the valve replaced when convenient; it will not hurt the engine but it will keep failing emissions tests.

issues.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
issues.sym: The gauge sticks, jumps, or shows more or less fuel than the tank really holds, so the range estimate cannot be trusted.
issues.why: The fuel level sending unit inside the tank wears out and sends the wrong signal to the gauge.
issues.next: Keep track of your mileage between fill-ups and have the sending unit replaced when convenient.

issues.t: Loose lug nut can let a wheel come off (recall 14V-229)
issues.sym: Clicking or knocking from a right-side wheel, or a wobble or vibration that gets worse.
issues.why: On some 2014 Rogues, one lug nut on each right-side wheel may not have been tightened at the factory. It can fall off and let the others loosen until the wheel separates (recall 14V-229).
issues.next: If you feel a wobble or hear clicking from a wheel, slow down and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN for recall 14V-229.

issues.t: Front brake caliper can come loose (recall 15V-012)
issues.sym: A clunk or grinding from a front wheel, weak braking, or the car pulling to one side.
issues.why: On some 2014–2015 Rogues built from August 12 to November 15, 2014, the front hub fasteners may not have been tightened right. A brake caliper can then come loose, which reduces braking and can affect steering (recall 15V-012).
issues.next: If braking feels weak or you hear a clunk or grinding from a front wheel, slow down and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN for recall 15V-012.

issues.t: Emergency braking can brake hard for no reason
issues.sym: The car suddenly brakes hard, often with a forward-collision warning, when nothing is in the way, such as near bridges, railroad tracks or parked cars.
issues.why: NHTSA opened an investigation (PE19-010) into about 554,000 2017–2018 Rogues after owner reports that the automatic emergency braking system activated with no obstacle in the path. Reports include low-speed crashes and minor injuries.
issues.next: If it happens, keep a firm grip, check your mirrors and get the car moving or off the road where it's safe. Ask a Nissan dealer to check for software updates for the radar and camera, keep the sensor area clean, and report each event to NHTSA.
